experience.title: Testing Site Coordinator
bullets: Managed paper-based logging for lateral flow test results during a high-volume period, where duplicate and lost records were common.
Began building small spreadsheet macros to catch duplicate entries, then learned C# to build a proper logging tool for the site.
Trained two colleagues on the new system, which reduced the back-and-forth needed to correct mismatched entries during the next wave.

projects.title: COVID 19 LFT Logging System
bullets: Built a C# logging system for recording and reporting lateral flow test results, replacing the site's paper-based process.
Designed the upload flow around a multi-record submission method used by testing institutions, still in active development.

projects.title: Wake
bullets: Wrote a command-line Wake-on-LAN tool in C# to remotely power on shared office machines before shifts.
